items.title: Mileage
items.desc: Odometer verification using data from 8,000+ sources across 25+ countries. Includes mileage trend chart and driving pattern analysis.

items.title: Damages
items.desc: Analysis of over 300 million records for damage history, repair records, and write-off status. Includes visual damage diagram.

items.title: Theft
items.desc: Cross-referencing with international stolen vehicle registries and official databases.

items.title: Vehicle Inspection
items.desc: Vehicle inspection history, test results, and any reported defects from official technical control records.

items.title: Fuel & CO2 Emissions
items.desc: Fuel consumption data (urban, extra-urban, combined) and CO2 emission class rating for the vehicle.

items.title: Natural Disasters
items.desc: Verification of the vehicle's exposure to natural disasters (floods, hail, storms) in its registration area.

trust.title: Powered by 8,000+ verified data sources
trust.body: Our reports draw from government registration and title records, insurance databases covering claims and total losses, and automotive auction platforms. We also integrate international stolen vehicle registries, manufacturer recall and warranty data, and maintenance records from authorized service centers. All cross-referenced across 25+ countries.

testimonials.title: What our users say
testimonials.subtitle: They checked before buying
testimonials.desc: Real feedback from buyers across Europe.

items.name: James Mitchell
items.text: The report saved me from buying a car with a rolled-back odometer. The mileage history clearly showed discrepancies the seller couldn't explain. Worth every penny.

items.name: Sophie Laurent
items.text: 2017 Golf 7, 98,000 km. The report confirmed regular maintenance and no anomalies detected. The seller was telling the truth, and it's reassuring to verify that with accurate data.

items.name: Marco Rossi
items.text: US import detected on a 2018 Mustang, with details on the original paint and a well-documented V8 engine. Really useful for getting a clear picture before committing.

items.name: Elena Kowalski
items.text: I had doubts about the mileage. The report flagged an inconsistency between 2019 and 2021. It saved me from buying a vehicle with a tampered odometer.

items.name: David Thompson
items.text: Detailed and well-structured report. It highlighted manufacturer data, prior taxi use, and multiple plate changes. Saved me a lot of stress before the purchase.
